defects.description: The canvas is completely empty and shows the default 'Empty canvas' placeholder state instead of the requested bar chart card.
No layout structure exists; no card, chart, axes, or data visualization elements are present on the canvas.

top_fixes: Generate the requested card component containing a bar chart visualization
Add the title 'Monthly Revenue' at the top of the card
Create six bars representing Jan through Jun with heights proportional to values 12k, 18k, 15k, 24k, 29k, and 33k
Place value labels (12k, 18k, etc.) above each corresponding bar

manifest.prompt: Create a card containing a bar chart titled 'Monthly Revenue' with six bars for Jan to Jun showing 12k, 18k, 15k, 24k, 29k and 33k, with value labels above each bar.
